summary:
Verified new 'Archivio Automatico' + 'PIN Magazzinieri' features end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (test_pin_archive.py). Frontend: all required flows pass at 390x844 (magazzino login, stato tracking, session persistence, logout; ufficio magazzinieri add + change PIN + delete; ufficio archivio search + empty + esegui).

Backend details — Magazzinieri: POST /api/magazzinieri (dup name 400, bad pin 422, auth 401, 200 for valid); GET /api/magazzinieri requires office auth; GET /api/magazzinieri/nomi public, returns only {id,nome} (no pin_hash). Login: POST /api/auth/magazzino/login — wrong PIN 401 with 'tentativ' remaining-count hint; after 5 wrongs → 429 lock with correct PIN also rejected during lock window; correct PIN returns {token,nome}; GET /api/auth/magazzino/me returns {id,nome}. Role separation verified: worker token on GET /api/pedane → 403; office token on PATCH /api/pedane/{id}/stato → 403. PUT /api/magazzinieri/{id}/pin invalidates existing worker sessions (old token → 401 on /me, new PIN login works). DELETE /api/magazzinieri/{id} also invalidates existing sessions.

Stato operatore: PATCH /api/pedane/{id}/stato with worker Bearer records arrivoCompletoDa=session.nome even when body includes operatore='HACKER' (session value wins). POST /api/ordini/scarica with worker Bearer also stamps worker nome.

Archivio: Created TEST order with dataConsegna 60d ago (2 pedane) + marked all 'completo' via worker token + a recent order (5d ago, completo) + an old-dated partial order (only 1/2 completo). POST /api/archivio/esegui → archiviati≥1 (only the old fully-completo). Verified: archived codici disappear from GET /api/pedane, /api/pedane/tutte, /api/pedane/cerca; recent & partial orders remain active; GET /api/archivio?q=TAG_OLD returns total=2 and items contain the codici; skip=0&limit=1 returns 1 item (pagination OK). POST /api/archivio/ripristina {numeroOrdine} → ripristinate=2; subsequent esegui does NOT re-archive restored (ripristinato flag honored); restored pedane reappear in /api/pedane.

Frontend details — Magazzino read-only (no login): magazzino-operatore-nome='Accedi', magazzino-readonly-hint visible, zero magazzino-scarica-ordine-button-* rendered. Login sheet (magazzino-nome-sheet): worker chips magazzino-worker-{id} rendered from /api/magazzinieri/nomi; wrong PIN shows 'tentativ' error message; correct PIN (via magazzino-pin-input + magazzino-nome-save-button) → magazzino-operatore-nome shows worker name. After login, searching TAG opens PedanaDetail (single-result auto-open, pre-existing). Marking completo via stato-segna-completo-button → arrivoCompletoDa=WNAME confirmed via GET /api/pedane/{id} AND 'da {WNAME}' string visible in page body. Session persisted after page reload (name still shown post-reload, SecureStore→localStorage). Logout via magazzino-nome-remove-button returns to read-only state.

Ufficio magazzinieri (/ufficio/magazzinieri): page loads with magazzinieri-nome-input, magazzinieri-pin-input, magazzinieri-add-button; adding a worker via UI succeeds and the magazzinieri-row-{id} is rendered. Clicking magazzinieri-pin-button-{id} opens the sheet with magazzinieri-new-pin-input + magazzinieri-new-pin-save-button. magazzinieri-delete-button-{id} opens confirm with magazzinieri-delete-confirm-button. Ufficio archivio (/ufficio/archivio): archivio-search-input, archivio-count ('0 pedane archiviate · 0 ordini'), archivio-esegui-button present; searching a non-matching string shows archivio-empty; clicking Archivia ora triggers toast 'Nessun ordine da archiviare' (expected since no real orders are >30 days old & complete).

All TEST workers and TEST pedane were cleaned up after each run. No real data was mutated.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L270-293: login_magazzino correctly stores failed count on the worker doc and locks after MAX_PIN_FAILS=5 for 5 minutes; resets on success. Lock check uses locked_until>now before pw check, so even correct PIN is rejected during lock window — matches spec.

server.py L447-460 PATCH /pedane/{id}/stato uses w['nome'] from the magazziniere session as operatore; the StatoReq model has no 'operatore' field, so any client-supplied operatore in the body is implicitly discarded by Pydantic — verified at runtime (body 'HACKER' → stored nome from session).
server.py L474-491 auto_archivia: filters out ripristinato:true to avoid re-archiving restored orders. Clean aggregation that groups by numeroOrdine, archives only when done==n and maxData<cutoff.
server.py L494-500 archive_loop runs hourly via asyncio.create_task — background task registered on startup; no issues observed.
magazzinieri.tsx L50 useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => void load(), [load])) — correct cleanup pattern for Expo Router; refreshes list on focus.
archivio.tsx L31-56 load() uses reqId.current to drop stale responses — good for debounced search; pagination via skip/limit is correctly plumbed with 'Carica altri' button.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required flows pass; sheet-overlay viewport scroll quirks are Playwright-only, not real UX bugs)

seed_data_creation: Each run creates TEST-prefixed workers (TESTPIN_*/TESTUI_*) and TEST pedane via POST /api/magazzinieri and POST /api/pedane; cleans up via DELETE /api/magazzinieri/{id} and DELETE /api/pedane/{id} in try/finally. Verified 0 leftover TEST* workers and 0 leftover TEST* pedane (active + archive) after test completion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://pedana-lookup.preview.emergentagent.com. Office pw: antolini2024. No seeded worker exists; tests must create+clean TEST workers. Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_pin_archive.py (14 pass). Key testIDs — Magazzino: magazzino-operatore-button, magazzino-operatore-nome, magazzino-readonly-hint, magazzino-nome-sheet, magazzino-worker-{id}, magazzino-pin-input, magazzino-nome-save-button, magazzino-nome-remove-button, magazzino-no-workers, stato-segna-completo-button, stato-segna-parziale-button. Ufficio magazzinieri: magazzinieri-nome-input, magazzinieri-pin-input, magazzinieri-add-button, magazzinieri-row-{id}, magazzinieri-pin-button-{id}, magazzinieri-new-pin-input, magazzinieri-new-pin-save-button, magazzinieri-delete-button-{id}, magazzinieri-delete-confirm-button. Ufficio archivio: archivio-search-input, archivio-count, archivio-esegui-button, archivio-ordine-{numero}, archivio-ripristina-button-{numero}, archivio-empty, archivio-load-more-button. Known Playwright quirk: Sheet component triggers 'Element is outside of the viewport' on normal .click() for buttons positioned in the bottom sheet — workaround: await page.evaluate("() => document.querySelector('[data-testid=...]').click()"). Also /api/pedane/cerca only matches codice/numeroOrdine (not merce/mittente), so searches for TAG tag return matches by codice. Single-result search in /magazzino auto-opens PedanaDetail (bypasses grouped list) — pre-existing behavior at magazzino.tsx L145. Session persistence uses SecureStore (web→localStorage) with MAG_TOKEN_KEY; verified a reload keeps the operator logged in.
rca_of_issue: N/A — new feature verification only; no regressions found.
